procedure_name: VIP / Fancy Vehicle Registration Number E-Auction
summary: Online competitive bidding for prestigious vehicle registration numbers (e.g. 0001, 0007, 9999).

steps.title: Register on Parivahan Fancy Number Portal
steps.description: Create bidder profile with Aadhaar and deposit non-refundable registration fee.

steps.title: Select desired registration number
steps.description: Search number availability in the active newly opened registration series.

steps.title: Deposit reserve price earnest money (EMD)
steps.description: Pay reserve price demand draft or online payment into auction escrow.

steps.title: Participate in live e-auction bidding
steps.description: Place incremental bids during active 48-hour auction bidding period.

steps.title: Collect Allotment Letter
steps.description: Highest bidder pays balance within 5 days and receives official Number Allotment Letter for vehicle registration.
